_comment: Optional settings. The engine works with all defaults and needs nothing here to run. It is fully keyless out of the box — no API keys required. (Heavy users can optionally add a free CoinGecko key for more speed; that goes in the MCP server's env block, not here. See TROUBLESHOOT.md.)
_team_note: Teams are weighted heavily (a real public team is a big plus) but are NEVER a disqualifier. Anonymous / no-public-team coins are flagged as a risk and tiered lower, not removed.
